subject: Anthropic debuts, US AI chip curbs on China in focus
notes: Issue is dated Thu, Nov 19 in its header. Headlines only; most items carry no event date.

stories.headline: Anthropic lists on Nasdaq, closing up 17% at $97.17 for a $1.3T market cap
stories.quote: ANTHROPIC CLOSES UP 17% AT $97.17 IN ITS NASDAQ DEBUT, GIVING IT A MARKET CAP OF $1.3T, AFTER OPENING AT $111.50, UP 34% FROM ITS IPO PRICE
stories.description: AI company; a public benefit corporation

facts.text: Closed up 17% at $97.17 on its Nasdaq debut, market cap $1.3T; opened at $111.50, up 34% from the IPO price.
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC CLOSES UP 17% AT $97.17 IN ITS NASDAQ DEBUT, GIVING IT A MARKET CAP OF $1.3T, AFTER OPENING AT $111.50, UP 34% FROM ITS IPO PRICE

facts.text: Anthropic is the US stock market's largest public benefit corporation; mandate overseen by a five-member Long-Term Benefit Trust.
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC BECOMES THE US STOCK MARKET'S LARGEST PUBLIC BENEFIT CORPORATION BY FAR; THE MANDATE IS OVERSEEN BY A FIVE-MEMBER “LONG-TERM BENEFIT TRUST”

facts.text: Filings: $1.1B of stock sold to retail investors in the UK, EU, Norway and Switzerland; UK investors bought 3.6M+ shares.
facts.quote: FILINGS: ANTHROPIC SOLD $1.1B OF STOCK TO RETAIL INVESTORS IN THE UK, THE EU, NORWAY, AND SWITZERLAND IN ITS RECORD IPO; UK INVESTORS BOUGHT 3.6M+ SHARES

facts.text: Sources: Menlo invested $1B+ for a ~1.5% stake, worth $20B+ at a $1.5T valuation; Lightspeed invested $3B+ and holds 2%+.
facts.quote: SOURCES: MENLO INVESTED $1B+ FOR A ~1.5% ANTHROPIC STAKE, WORTH $20B+ AT A $1.5T VALUATION; LIGHTSPEED, THE TOP FINANCIAL INVESTOR, INVESTED $3B+ AND HOLDS 2%+

facts.text: Source: ICONIQ invested more than $6B; its estimated 1.8% stake was worth ~$31.8B at Thursday's close.
facts.quote: SOURCE: ICONIQ INVESTED MORE THAN $6B IN ANTHROPIC; ITS ESTIMATED 1.8% STAKE WAS WORTH ~$31.8B AT THURSDAY'S CLOSE, A 430%+ RETURN ON INVESTMENT

facts.text: Sources: more than half of bidding institutional investors got no shares; allocations favoured US investors.
facts.quote: SOURCES: ANTHROPIC'S IPO LEFT 50%+ OF BIDDING INSTITUTIONAL INVESTORS WITH ZERO SHARES; ALLOCATIONS HEAVILY FAVORED US INVESTORS, SHUTTING OUT FOREIGN ORDERS

facts.text: Described as the largest IPO on record; employee interviews show muted enthusiasm.
facts.quote: INTERVIEWS WITH ANTHROPIC EMPLOYEES, OR ANTS, REVEAL MUTED ENTHUSIASM AHEAD OF THE LARGEST IPO ON RECORD, AS THEY DEBATE THE PACE OF FRONTIER AI DEVELOPMENT

facts.text: FT analysis: Anthropic needs ~$602B in annual revenue for a 20% return on invested capital.
facts.quote: ANALYSIS: ANTHROPIC NEEDS ~$602B IN ANNUAL REVENUE TO HIT A 20% RETURN ON INVESTED CAPITAL COMPARABLE TO ITS BIG TECH PEERS; APPLE HAS $478B IN ANNUAL REVENUE

stories.quote: A UK TRIBUNAL RULES AGAINST THE UK HOME OFFICE, SAYING IT MUST ACKNOWLEDGE ISSUING A SECRET “TECHNICAL CAPABILITY NOTICE” TO APPLE TO BYPASS ITS ENCRYPTION
